name: B10-0086/2026 (ECR) – Conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Hong Kong's conviction of Jimmy Lai, a British national and newspaper founder, under the China-imposed National Security Law. It calls his prosecution politically motivated and says it breaks international human rights rules. It asks Hong Kong and Chinese authorities to release him and everyone jailed for peacefully using their rights. It also asks the European Union to keep human rights central to its relations with China and to review Hong Kong's special trade status.

- The Parliament only states its opinion; nothing changes in law.
- It targets Hong Kong and Chinese authorities, and European Union relations with China.
- The European Union's delegation in Hong Kong is asked to monitor his case.
